_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

boe_per_day.basis: third quarter total production, barrels of oil equivalent per day

qoq_pct.basis: increase on the prior quarter, percent

oil_per_day.basis: third quarter average daily crude oil, barrels

oil_share_pct.basis: computed: crude oil barrels over total barrels of oil equivalent, percent, rounded to one decimal

fastest_ft_per_day.basis: the company's fastest well, over this many feet a day

hours_per_day.basis: computed: the hours in the day c8's feet per day is spread over, the divisor of fastest_ft_per_hour

fastest_ft_per_hour.basis: computed: the 2,700 feet a day over 24 hours, rounded to one decimal

capex_musd.basis: third quarter cash capital expenditures, millions of dollars

net_acres.basis: approximately this many net acres, West Texas and Southeast New Mexico

oil_4q_over.basis: expected fourth quarter oil production, over this many MBbls/d

texas_lease_pct.basis: share of net leasehold acreage in Texas at year end 2025

nm_lease_pct.basis: share of net leasehold acreage in New Mexico at year end 2025

ai_tools.basis: computed: the AI tools the release names (the artificial lift monitor and the language models)

llm_uses.basis: computed: the uses the release names for the language models

days_since_rrc.basis: computed: days from the Tribune's May 21st, 2026 report to the November 4th, 2026 release

xom_technologies.basis: more than this many technologies ExxonMobil is deploying in the Permian

xom_automate_year.basis: the year end by which ExxonMobil plans to automate more than half its unconventional fleet

xom_target_mboe.basis: ExxonMobil's Permian target, million oil-equivalent barrels a day

xom_target_year.basis: the year of ExxonMobil's Permian target
